svg.aria-label: vibecook: ingredients for the app you're cooking
svg.title: vibecook: ingredients for the app you're cooking
svg.desc: The marks of four projects on one baseline: truffle, a mesh network; ghosttea, a terminal; mille, a file tree; and flux, a media server. Arcs run from truffle to each of the other three, and from mille to flux. Underneath: truffle is the network under the other three.
